answer: The "Lighthouse" mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring AI agents to deposit a digital "nectar" token, which is burned upon successful participation in consensus. This token serves as a proof-of-stake, discouraging attackers from creating fake identities. The "Lighthouse" mechanism is akin to a digital "lantern" guiding honest AI agents, while isolating malicious ones on a "digital island" of their own making.
